title: An Ultra-Low-Power 9.8GHz Crystal-Less UWB Transceiver with Digital Baseband Integrated in 0.18µm BiCMOS
figure_number: Figure 25.2.1: System block diagram of the entire crystal-less UWB radio.
design_purpose: To reduce both power and area, the radio includes a relaxation oscillator with a modified RC network and a single-ended hysteretic comparator for on-chip clocking (Fig. 25.2.3).
